responsibility: Implements the mutable semantic `Scope` object used while analyzing D code. It manages scope allocation/reuse, push/pop nesting, CTFE scope flags, field-initialization tracking, constructor-flow merging, global-scope creation for modules, lexical and imported-symbol lookup, insertion into the nearest symbol table, enclosing aggregate lookup, alignment queries, and spelling-correction helpers for unresolved identifiers, providing the operational behavior behind the `scope.h` data structure.
